propositions: Legacy stores without .bridge_state/projects.json must seed a one-project mapping with legacy_default equal to Backend.project without writing ticket events or EDIT mutations.

Two new ensure units (projects-seed and projects-compat-stamp) must be registered as idempotent, check-then-act migrations in the REGISTRY that converge stores at init, re-init, fsck --repair, and MCP boot.

A converged single-project store must not add multi-project-bridge to required_capabilities; a two-project store must add exactly that token as a backstop when present in the mapping but missing from .store-compat.json.

The projects-seed unit must write zero commits when the mapping already exists (tree-check committed blob before committing); a second sweep must return ok and leave the tickets-branch tip SHA unchanged.
A two-project stamped store must still pass check_store_compat on this binary because multi-project-bridge is registered in KNOWN_CAPABILITIES.
A raised exception in any ensure unit must be recorded failed and not abort the sweep or caller.
